newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpha-Beta rating upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpha-Beta rating upgraded.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Wednesday it upgraded its rating for Alpha-Beta Technologies Inc to buy from attractive in anticipation of positive product test data and a corporate partner.

-- Vector said Alpha-Beta recently completed enrollment of its Phase III trial for Betafectin, which aims to reduce infections following high-risk gastrointestinal surgery. The test results are expected to be impressive, Vector said.

-- Betafectin is the only late-stage product in Alpha-Beta's product line, making the risk associated with the success of the this latest trial greater than for many biotechnology companies, Vector said.
-- Alpha-Beta is expected to file for permission to market the product in the third quarter of 1997 and align with a partner in the first half of the year, Vector said.
-- Alpha-Beta is a pharmaceutical development firm.
-- Its shares closed up 1-1/4 Wednesday at 12-1/2.
